items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And we had a fellow named Green on trombone.

ctx.x: And we had a fellow named Green on trombone. I don't know what ever happened to that guy. Very good trombone player. And we had Max Maddox Mack Madison on trumpet. We had -- that's a boy -- he committed suicide. I don't know what ever happened to him -- after he came back from the war.
Well, I mean it was a full size, big * Lincoln Mills
